moment.title: Hardware Lab table
moment.place: Beside a blue "Hardware Lab" table in a room with white walls and a concrete floor
moment.summary: The recording shows a blue table with a Major League Hacking "Hardware Lab" tablecloth in a room with white walls and a concrete floor. Three stacked boxes and some cards sit on a second blue table beside it, and a person in dark clothes lies on the floor by the wall. The view stays on the same scene the whole time.

facts.text: The words "Major League Hacking" were printed under the MLH letters.

facts.cue: A couple of little signs were laid flat on the table.

facts.text: A second blue table next to it had small cards and papers spread out.
